name: Poseur de traverses
description: Very tall muscular adult, brown-grey mottled hide, massive low rectangular crest, large four mandibles, heavy long dreads. Reinforced dark green lifting harness over grey sleeveless tunic, steel shoulder covers, split short apron. Holds a single short thick timber brace vertically tight to one side, other hand gripping a small construction clamp; timber stops below head and above knees. Weight counterbalanced.
